verses.he: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר לַֽ֭יהוָה הָאָ֣רֶץ וּמְלוֹאָ֑הּ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.en: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’S, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein.
For He hath founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the floods.
Who shall ascend into the mountain of the LORD? And who shall stand in His holy place?

verses.he: נְקִ֥י כַפַּ֗יִם וּֽבַר־לֵ֫בָ֥ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀ לֹא־נָשָׂ֣א לַשָּׁ֣וְא נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לְמִרְמָֽה׃
verses.en: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not taken My name in vain, And hath not sworn deceitfully.

verses.he: יִשָּׂ֣א בְ֭רָכָה מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה מֵאֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, And righteousness from the God of his salvation.

verses.he: זֶ֭ה דּ֣וֹר דרשו [דֹּרְשָׁ֑יו] מְבַקְשֵׁ֨י פָנֶ֖יךָ יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: Such is the generation of them that seek after Him, That seek Thy face, even Jacob. Selah

verses.he: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים׀ רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭הִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָב֗וֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates, And be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors; That the King of glory may come in.

verses.he: מִ֥י זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְ֭הוָה עִזּ֣וּז וְגִבּ֑וֹר יְ֝הוָ֗ה גִּבּ֥וֹר מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.en: 'Who is the King of glory?' 'The LORD strong and mighty, The LORD mighty in battle.'

verses.he: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים׀ רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וּ֭שְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָבֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates, Yea, lift them up, ye everlasting doors; That the King of glory may come in.

verses.he: מִ֤י ה֣וּא זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת ה֤וּא מֶ֖לֶךְ הַכָּב֣וֹד סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: 'Who then is the King of glory?' 'The LORD of hosts; He is the King of glory.' Selah
